## SECTION 2: PURPOSE

_Slug: purpose_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 1. SOP-AST-XXXXX CCI Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 2_

_Signals: low (words=62, tables=0)_

- The purpose of this Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) is to describe the process for creation and maintenance of public disclosure standards for determining Company Confidential Information (CCI) (herein referred to as public disclosure standards) applied to Astellas public disclosures (i.e., data and documents made publicly available). This SOP will also describe the process for collecting, compiling and tracking information on public disclosures.

---

## SECTION 3: SCOPE

_Slug: scope_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 1. SOP-AST-XXXXX CCI Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 3_

_Signals: medium (words=185, tables=0)_

- This SOP applies to Astellas employees and non-employees who are involved in or contribute to public disclosure standards and tracking of the public disclosure activities of clinical studies (and the products in these studies) as mandated by laws/regulations. This SOP applies to Astellas information, data and/or documents that are made publicly available in support of public disclosure of clinical study information (including product information).

- The public domains in scope are listed in the OVERVIEW Section.

- Anonymization standards for documents for public disclosure are covered by STL-1938 Guide for Creating Redacted Documents for Public Disclosure.

- The following organizations are in scope of this document:

- Alliance Management

- Clinical Operations

- Communications & Investor Relations

- Data Science

- Development Project Management

- Early Development

- Legal & Intellectual Property

- Medical Affairs (MA)

- Pharmacovigilance (PV)

- Primary Focus Development Divisions (PFDDs)

- Regulatory Affairs (RA)

- Research

- Technology & Manufacturing

- This SOP does not apply to corporate disclosures and/or media/investor relations disclosures, or information, data or documents shared with a third party or business partners under a relevant contractual or collaborative agreement. Refer to POL-1048 Disclosure Policy and POL-317 Global Policy on Third Party Lifecycle Management.

---

## SECTION 4: DEFINITIONS

_Slug: definitions_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 1. SOP-AST-XXXXX CCI Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 4_

_Signals: medium (words=20, tables=1)_

- For definitions, refer to Enterprise Master Definition List.

- Please see table below for definitions that are specific for this document:

**Table 1 (definitions_table_1):**

| Term | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Company Confidential Information (CCI) | In the context of this SOP and CCI included in public disclosures, CCI may refer to any non-public technical, scientific, business and other know-how and information, trade secrets, results and data of any type whatsoever in any media or format, including without limitation, ideas, discoveries, inventions, trade secrets, practices, manufacturing or analytical methods, tests, testing results, assays, techniques, specifications, processes, formulations, formulae, knowledge, know-how, skill, experience, materials, products and compositions, studies and procedures, drawings, plans, designs, diagrams, sketches, technology, databases, documentation or descriptions. Such data or information is also known as proprietary information. Confidential Information may also include intellectual property. / Any Confidential Information relating to the business activities of Astellas. This includes data or information that might be useful to competitors or that could be harmful to the company or others with whom Astellas does business if such data or information were disclosed, and includes data vital to the continued, successful operation of Astellas. |
| Data | A piece of information (e.g., numerical, word) in any format/medium whether it is directly entered into a database or provided in a document. |
| Disclosing Party | Astellas employees and non-employees who will disclose information publicly. |
| Document | Any document provided for public disclosure, including but are not limited to: clinical study documents, marketing application modules, manuscripts, scientific publications, abstracts or presentations. |
| Public Disclosure | The act of sharing Astellas information (i.e., data and/or document) of clinical study information (including product information) in the public domain. |
| Public domain | The state of belonging or being available to the public, and therefore not subject to copyright.  Refer to the OVERVIEW Section for the list of public domains in scope. |

---

## SECTION 5: OVERVIEW

_Slug: overview_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 1. SOP-AST-XXXXX CCI Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 5_

_Signals: medium (words=198, tables=1)_

- Disclosure of clinical study information as well as product information in clinical studies has increased in recent years due to implementation of disclosure regulations.

- The data and documents that must be disclosed by study sponsors/applicants or Marketing Authorization Holders (MAH) can contain the following, due to these regulations:

- Companyâ€™s information (company-related secrets and procedures) which, if released, could result in significant harm to the companyâ€™s competitive market position and financial loss and give a significant advantage to its competitors,

- and/or

- Study participants or study personnel personal information (PI; also known as protected personal data (PPD)).

- A companyâ€™s information classified as CCI, must not be released to the public. Astellas commits to following these disclosure regulations and ensuring the protection and consistency of Astellas public disclosures in the public domain. Public domains in which Astellasâ€™ information are disclosed include, but are not limited to, the following:

- Standards Overview

- To allow consistent data classification, GUIDE-AST-XXXX CCI Public Disclosure Standards was developed. Based on new information, approach, regulations and/or requirements, CCI Public Disclosure Standards may evolve and will be updated when necessary.

- Furthermore, FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library, will be used as the basis for Asset-specific classification and described in this procedure.

**Table 1 (overview_table_1):**

| Phase 1-4 |
| --- |
| ClinicaTrials.gov / CTIS (EU CTR) / EU Clinical Trials Register (EU Directive, via EudraCT) / Japan jRCT / National/country specific registries / Company website (e.g., Astellas Clinical Trials) / Third-party website (e.g., TrialSummaries.com hosted by TrialScope) / Scientific journal websites/databases / Materials presented during scientific events and conferences |
| Phase 4 Additional Databases |
| HMA-EMA Catalogues of RWD studies (Non-interventional studies) / Health Authorities clinical data public websites/databases / Ad-hoc requests for Astellas documents submitted to EMA (Policy 0043) |

## SECTION 8: Creating a CCI Asset-specific Library for Public Disclosure

_Slug: creating_a_cci_asset_specific_library_for_public_disclosure_

_Layout: Heading 2_

_Source: 1. SOP-AST-XXXXX CCI Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 8_

_Signals: medium (words=109, tables=1)_

- It is essential that Asset-specific CCI is classified and disclosed in a consistent manner. Between Candidate Nomination (CN) Declaration and Investigational New Drug (IND) milestones, FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library should be initiated and developed. Re-assessment of existing CCI should be made when the Asset moves to a different development phase e.g., Phase 1 to Phase 2 or when changes to Asset-specific CCIs are identified.

- The Asset Lead, in collaboration with the Asset Team, determines what information is considered CCI for the Asset. The Asset Lead is responsible for ensuring that FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library is created and reviewed for the asset prior to each of the asset development phases.

**Table 1 (creating_a_cci_asset_specific_library_for_public_disclosure_table_1):**

| Responsibility | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Public Disclosure Lead | Consult with Asset Lead or Delegate to initiate FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library. |
| Asset Lead or Delegate | Identify Asset-specific data as CCI using GUIDE-AST-XXXX CCI Public Disclosure Standards. / NOTE:  In GUIDE-AST-XXXX CCI Public Disclosure Standards, for "Information that May Be Considered CCIâ€, consult with the Subject Matter Expert, Department Head and/or appropriate Legal department, for guidance on appropriate CCI classification. |
| Asset Lead or Delegate | Document Asset-specific data in the Asset-specific FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library, in collaboration with Asset Team. |
| Asset Lead or Delegate | Inform the Public Disclosure Lead that the FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library is final. |
| Public Disclosure Lead | Archive the final FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library. |
| Public Disclosure Lead | Inform the Disclosing Parties and Asset Lead that the final FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library is available for use. |

---

For example, the data is no longer classified as CCI. This should be reflected in FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library. |

## SECTION 5: CCI PUBLIC DISCLOSURE STANDARDS

_Slug: cci_public_disclosure_standards_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 2. GUIDE-AST-XXXX CCI Public Disclosure Standards.docx | docx | Section 5_

_Signals: medium (words=0, tables=1)_

**Table 1 (cci_public_disclosure_standards_table_1):**

| Information that May Be Considered CCI / <Throughout all phases of development, from preclinical to Phase 1 to post-marketing Phase 4, and gradually decreasing as the asset moves into later stages of development.> | Information Not Considered CCI / <Information relating to the nonclinical and clinical development of the medicinal product is not, per se, commercially confidential.> |
| --- | --- |
| CMC/Quality Related Information | CMC/Quality Related Information |
| Drug Substance / Names and structure of active substance in early development stages / Quantitative composition for the active substance and excipients (formulated substances only) / Metabolites: Structural formula(s) of the active metabolite(s) and metabolic pathway(s) from which the manufacturing process of the active substance can be deduced and the disclosure of which could harm the legitimate interests of the company / Polymorphism, isomer, amino acid sequence, detailed information of study outcomes / Impurities: Descriptions of related substances and impurities, qualitative and quantitative information / Drug substance manufacturing methods and processes: detailed information on manufacturing processes, characterization, pharm. development, validation, analytical methods, in-process controls, justification of specification, amino acid sequence (new substances), cell clones to express protein/vector, impurities and degradants / Quantitative acceptance criteria for intermediates and active substances / Drug substance batch size: production scale (commercial scale) / Drug substance manufacturers and suppliers: manufacturing sites, bulk manufacturers (except manufacturer of the biological active substance), excipients manufacturers, packaging site(s), batch control/testing site(s), details about facilities, partners/third parties such as suppliers, CMO, CROs, etc. / Drug Product / Quantitative composition for drug product (finished product) / Drug product formulation development (not marketed formulations) / Drug product clinical batches: e.g. dissolution profiles of tablets, details on dissolution methods / Company (In-house) developed cells and strains (when not in commercial is and not yet published) / Drug product manufacturing methods and processes: detailed information on manufacturing processes, characterization, pharm. development, validation, analytical methods, in-process controls, justification of specification, adventitious agents safety information/virus removal validation, Post-approval Change Management Protocols (PACMPs) / Quantitative acceptance criteria for intermediates and drug product / Drug product batch size: production scale (commercial scale) / Drug product novel excipients information / Drug product manufacturers and suppliers: manufacturing sites, bulk manufacturers (except manufacturer of the biological active substance), excipients manufacturers, packaging site(s), batch control/testing site(s), details about facilities, partners/third parties such as suppliers, CMO, CROs, etc / Drug product packaging: technical specifications of the packaging such as color code, font, dimensions, etc. / AAV In Vivo Gene Therapy: / The fact that the synthesis or manufacturing procedure was changed / The fact that the formulation was changed during the development program and the description of changes and bioequivalence tests | All other information is considered disclosable, including: / The name of a cell line or strain with genetic recombination, when in commercial use or already published (e.g., CHO cell, E. ## SECTION 1: 2-May Data Disclosure Standards WS1 Workshop Minutes

_Slug: 2_may_data_disclosure_standards_ws1_workshop_minutes_

_Layout: Document_

_Source: 2-May Data Disclosure Standards WS1 Workshop Minutes.docx | docx | Section 1_

_Signals: high (words=736, tables=1)_

- Data Disclosure Project WS1 Workshop
- Meeting Minutes

- May 2, 2024

- Materials: Recording

- Agenda

- Review summary of Feedback on Data Disclosure Standards

- Align on Proposed Solutions

- Next Steps

- Discussion Notes ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

- Data Disclosure Standards Workbook was used to drive the discussion during the workshop. Marta led the discussion with providing summary of collected feedback from participants and proposed solution based on the feedback received. For detailed summary and proposed solution refer to the workbook circulated in the meeting invite.

- The notes below describe the discussion and key decisions related to the workbook.

- Data Disclosure (DD) Standards Document Format

- Discussed the future format of the plan data disclosure standards document.

- Proposed to create a quality process document to make the use of the standards mandatory.

- The quality document (QD) will be associated with a form called the "Library of CCI Standards"

- Each asset lead will use the library of CCI standards to determine the asset-specific standards that will be documented and maintained as the CCI Asset Library.

- The team agreed on the proposed solution for the future format of the document.

- Purpose Section

- Informed the group that the scope/purpose of this document is limited to what is shared in public domain.

- The new quality document will cover both development and post-marketing disclosures.

- Team will clarify in the document that it also covers the post-marketing disclosures.

- The team agreed to strive for consistency across all asset teams in identifying what information is considered confidential.

- Team will predefine in the library of CCI standards which standards should always be considered confidential.

- Team agreed on the proposed solution for the purpose section of the document. Final language will be determined during QD update.

- Scope Section

- Team was informed that the scope sections were revised based on feedback. The scope will focus on CCI. Personal information and anonymization is not in scope.

- The In Scope and Out of Scope sections have been combined into a single Scope section, and the Scope description has been revised.

- The definition of public disclosure was also revised to make it clear that it refers to the act of sharing Astellas information in the public domain.

- The new quality document will provide the final wording of the scope and definition.

- Clarification was requested for inclusion of patient advocacy group

- Marta will follow up with the Patient Centricity team to get more information about the process of sharing information with patient advocacy groups

- Team in agreement with the revised scope and proposed solution

- CCI Criteria and Determination Section

- Provided overview of the general feedback received on CCI Standards.

- Clarification was requested regarding information not considered CCI if available via search engines

- Marta to follow up with David Aschermann (provided comment and questioned the first criteria) and Mirna (Legal IP) to get feedback on the first criteria for determining confidential information.

- Clarification on potential CCI from other parties, either a (co) development partner or a vendor was requested from the team

- Mirna (Legal IP) suggested connecting with Legal Regulatory team to see if there are any contract templates. In general she noted that they always make sure that Astellas are the owners of information and make sure that is discussed in advanced with the vendors/co-development partners.

- Overall the team was in agreement with the defined criteria

- CCI Asset Library Tool Section

- Several suggestions were provided for storage and maintenance of the tool to ensure there is a defined process for governance, review, maintenance and access.

- Team was informed that all suggestions will be considered on storage and maintenance process along with format during quality document development.

- Team in agreement with the proposed solution

- Core Team Action Items:

- Marta will review the notes and recording of the meeting and reflect updates in quality documents in development.

- Marta to connect with Patient Centricity Group to understand if inclusion of patient advocacy group is needed in CCI standards

- Marta to connect with David Aschermann and Mirna (Legal IP) to get feedback on the first criteria for determining confidential information.

- Marta to connect with the Legal Regulatory to align on requirements for CCI disclosures related to co-development partners and vendors.

- Workgroup Action Items / Next Steps:

- Workshop participants to review the DD standards workbook with function leads. If there are any major concerns or issues, please let us know by May 22nd.

- The project core team will start working on developing the supporting quality documents and circulate to this group for initial feedback.

**Table 1 (2_may_data_disclosure_standards_ws1_workshop_minutes_table_1):**

| Attendees / Marta Nabielec / Farhad Fazel / Mary Johnson / Challoth Clarke / Mary-Ann Cafuta / Bert van Leeuwen / Bernadette Lim | David Aschermann / Sarah Snider / Pauline Walstra / Mirna Atallah / Kate Mills-Lujan / Maria Ayala / Charmi Doshi |
| --- | --- |
|   |   |

## SECTION 2: PURPOSE

_Slug: purpose_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 20241002-Emily2 Comments 1. SOP-AST-XXXXX CCI Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 2_

_Signals: low (words=62, tables=0)_

- The purpose of this Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) is to describe the process for creation and maintenance of public disclosure standards for determining Company Confidential Information (CCI) (herein referred to as public disclosure standards) applied to Astellas public disclosures (i.e., data and documents made publicly available). This SOP will also describe the process for collecting, compiling and tracking information on public disclosures.

---

## SECTION 3: SCOPE

_Slug: scope_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 20241002-Emily2 Comments 1. SOP-AST-XXXXX CCI Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 3_

_Signals: medium (words=185, tables=0)_

- This SOP applies to Astellas employees and non-employees who are involved in or contribute to public disclosure standards and tracking of the public disclosure activities of clinical studies (and the products in these studies) as mandated by laws/regulations. This SOP applies to Astellas information, data and/or documents that are made publicly available in support of public disclosure of clinical study information (including product information).

- The public domains in scope are listed in the OVERVIEW Section.

- Anonymization standards for documents for public disclosure are covered by STL-1938 Guide for Creating Redacted Documents for Public Disclosure.

- The following organizations are in scope of this document:

- Alliance Management

- Clinical Operations

- Communications & Investor Relations

- Data Science

- Development Project Management

- Early Development

- Legal & Intellectual Property

- Medical Affairs (MA)

- Pharmacovigilance (PV)

- Primary Focus Development Divisions (PFDDs)

- Regulatory Affairs (RA)

- Research

- Technology & Manufacturing

- This SOP does not apply to corporate disclosures and/or media/investor relations disclosures, or information, data or documents shared with a third party or business partners under a relevant contractual or collaborative agreement. Refer to POL-1048 Disclosure Policy and POL-317 Global Policy on Third Party Lifecycle Management.

---

## SECTION 4: DEFINITIONS

_Slug: definitions_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 20241002-Emily2 Comments 1. SOP-AST-XXXXX CCI Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 4_

_Signals: medium (words=20, tables=1)_

- For definitions, refer to Enterprise Master Definition List.

- Please see table below for definitions that are specific for this document:

**Table 1 (definitions_table_1):**

| Term | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Company Confidential Information (CCI) | In the context of this SOP and CCI included in public disclosures, CCI may refer to any non-public technical, scientific, business and other know-how and information, trade secrets, results and data of any type whatsoever in any media or format, including without limitation, ideas, discoveries, inventions, trade secrets, practices, manufacturing or analytical methods, tests, testing results, assays, techniques, specifications, processes, formulations, formulae, knowledge, know-how, skill, experience, materials, products and compositions, studies and procedures, drawings, plans, designs, diagrams, sketches, technology, databases, documentation or descriptions. Such data or information is also known as proprietary information. Confidential Information may also include intellectual property. / Any Confidential Information relating to the business activities of Astellas. This includes data or information that might be useful to competitors or that could be harmful to the company or others with whom Astellas does business if such data or information were disclosed, and includes data vital to the continued, successful operation of Astellas. |
| Data | A piece of information (e.g., numerical, word) in any format/medium whether it is directly entered into a database or provided in a document. |
| Disclosing Party | Astellas employees and non-employees who will disclose information publicly. |
| Document | Any document provided for public disclosure, including but are not limited to: clinical study documents, marketing application modules, manuscripts, scientific publications, abstracts or presentations. |
| Public Disclosure | The act of sharing Astellas information (i.e., data and/or document) of clinical study information (including product information) in the public domain. |
| Public domain | The state of belonging or being available to the public, and therefore not subject to copyright.  Refer to the OVERVIEW Section for the list of public domains in scope. |

---

## SECTION 5: OVERVIEW

_Slug: overview_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 20241002-Emily2 Comments 1. SOP-AST-XXXXX CCI Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 5_

_Signals: medium (words=198, tables=1)_

- Disclosure of clinical study information as well as product information in clinical studies has increased in recent years due to implementation of disclosure regulations.

- The data and documents that must be disclosed by study sponsors/applicants or Marketing Authorization Holders (MAH) can contain the following, due to these regulations:

- Companyâ€™s information (company-related secrets and procedures) which, if released, could result in significant harm to the companyâ€™s competitive market position and financial loss and give a significant advantage to its competitors,

- and/or

- Study participants or study personnel personal information (PI; also known as protected personal data (PPD)).

- A companyâ€™s information classified as CCI, must not be released to the public. Astellas commits to following these disclosure regulations and ensuring the protection and consistency of Astellas public disclosures in the public domain. Public domains in which Astellasâ€™ information are disclosed include, but are not limited to, the following:

- Standards Overview

- To allow consistent data classification, GUIDE-AST-XXXX CCI Public Disclosure Standards was developed. Based on new information, approach, regulations and/or requirements, CCI Public Disclosure Standards may evolve and will be updated when necessary.

- Furthermore, FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library, will be used as the basis for Asset-specific classification and described in this procedure.

**Table 1 (overview_table_1):**

| Phase 1-4 |
| --- |
| ClinicaTrials.gov / CTIS (EU CTR) / EU Clinical Trials Register (EU Directive, via EudraCT) / Japan jRCT / National/country specific registries / Company website (e.g., Astellas Clinical Trials) / Third-party website (e.g., TrialSummaries.com hosted by TrialScope) / Scientific journal websites/databases / Materials presented during scientific events and conferences |
| Phase 4 Additional Databases |
| HMA-EMA Catalogues of RWD studies (Non-interventional studies) / Health Authorities clinical data public websites/databases / Ad-hoc requests for Astellas documents submitted to EMA (Policy 0043) |

---

## SECTION 8: Creating a CCI Asset-specific Library for Public Disclosure

_Slug: creating_a_cci_asset_specific_library_for_public_disclosure_

_Layout: Heading 2_

_Source: 20241002-Emily2 Comments 1. SOP-AST-XXXXX CCI Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 8_

_Signals: medium (words=109, tables=1)_

- It is essential that Asset-specific CCI is classified and disclosed in a consistent manner. Between Candidate Nomination (CN) Declaration and Investigational New Drug (IND) milestones, FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library should be initiated and developed. Re-assessment of existing CCI should be made when the Asset moves to a different development phase e.g., Phase 1 to Phase 2 or when changes to Asset-specific CCIs are identified.

- The Asset Lead, in collaboration with the Asset Team, determines what information is considered CCI for the Asset. The Asset Lead is responsible for ensuring that FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library is created and reviewed for the asset prior to each of the asset development phases.

**Table 1 (creating_a_cci_asset_specific_library_for_public_disclosure_table_1):**

| Responsibility | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Public Disclosure Lead | Consult with Asset Lead or Delegate to initiate FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library. |
| Asset Lead or Delegate | Identify Asset-specific data as CCI using GUIDE-AST-XXXX CCI Public Disclosure Standards. / NOTE:  In GUIDE-AST-XXXX CCI Public Disclosure Standards, for "Information that May Be Considered CCIâ€, consult with the Subject Matter Expert, Department Head and/or appropriate Legal department, for guidance on appropriate CCI classification. |
| Asset Lead or Delegate | Document Asset-specific data in the Asset-specific FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library, in collaboration with Asset Team. |
| Asset Lead or Delegate | Inform the Public Disclosure Lead that the FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library is final. |
| Public Disclosure Lead | Archive the final FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library. |
| Public Disclosure Lead | Inform the Disclosing Parties and Asset Lead that the final FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library is available for use. |

## SECTION 2: PURPOSE

_Slug: purpose_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 240910 pre-meeting - 1. SOP-AST-XXXXX Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 2_

_Signals: low (words=62, tables=0)_

- The purpose of this Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) is to describe the process for creation and maintenance of public disclosure standards for determining Company Confidential Information (CCI) (herein referred to as public disclosure standards) applied to Astellas public disclosures (i.e., data and documents made publicly available). This SOP will also describe the process for collecting, compiling and reporting information on public disclosures.

---

## SECTION 3: SCOPE

_Slug: scope_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 240910 pre-meeting - 1. SOP-AST-XXXXX Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 3_

_Signals: medium (words=180, tables=0)_

- This SOP applies to Astellas employees and non-employees who are involved in or contribute to public disclosure standards and tracking of the public disclosure activities of clinical studies (and the products in these studies) as mandated by laws/regulations. This SOP applies to Astellas information, data and/or documents that are made publicly available in support of public disclosure of clinical study information (including product information). The public domains in scope are listed in the OVERVIEW Section.  Anonymization standards for documents are covered by SOP-AST-XXXX Title.

- The following organizations are in scope of this document:

- Alliance Management

- Clinical Operations

- Commercial

- Communications

- External Relations & Advocacy

- Data Science

- Development Project Management

- DigitalX

- Early Development

- Intellectual Property

- Legal

- Medical Affairs (MA)

- Pharmacovigilance (PV)

- Primary Focus Development Divisions (PFDDs)

- Regulatory Affairs (RA)

- Research

- Rx+ Business Accelerator

- Technology & Manufacturing

- This SOP does not apply to corporate disclosures and/or media/investor relations disclosures, or information, data or documents shared with a third party or business partner under a relevant contractual or collaborative agreement. Refer to POL-1048 Disclosure Policy and POL-317 Global Policy on Third Party Lifecycle Management.

---

## SECTION 4: DEFINITIONS

_Slug: definitions_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 240910 pre-meeting - 1. SOP-AST-XXXXX Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 4_

_Signals: medium (words=20, tables=1)_

- For definitions, refer to Enterprise Master Definition List.

- Please see table below for definitions that are specific for this document:

**Table 1 (definitions_table_1):**

| Term | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Company Confidential Information (CCI) | In the context of this SOP and CCI included in public disclosures, CCI may refer to any non-public technical, scientific, business and other know-how and information, trade secrets, results and data of any type whatsoever in any media or format, including without limitation, ideas, discoveries, inventions, trade secrets, practices, manufacturing or analytical methods, tests, testing results, assays, techniques, specifications, processes, formulations, formulae, knowledge, know-how, skill, experience, materials, products and compositions, studies and procedures, drawings, plans, designs, diagrams, sketches, technology, databases, documentation or descriptions. Such data or information is also known as proprietary information. Confidential Information may also include intellectual property. / Any Confidential Information relating to the business activities of Astellas. This includes data or information that might be useful to competitors or that could be harmful to the company or others with whom Astellas does business if such data or information were disclosed, and includes data vital to the continued, successful operation of Astellas.  Refer to Attachment 2 Company Confidential Information (CCI) Decision Criteria. |
| Data | A piece of information (e.g., numerical, word) in any format/medium whether it is directly entered into a database or provided in a document. |
| Disclosing Party | Astellas employees and non-employees who will disclose information publicly. |
| Document | Any document provided for public disclosure, including but are not limited to: clinical study documents, marketing application modules, manuscripts, scientific publications, abstracts or presentations. |
| Public Disclosure | The act of sharing Astellas information (i.e., data and/or document) of clinical study information (including product information) in the public domain. |
| Public domain |   |

## SECTION 5: OVERVIEW

_Slug: overview_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 240910 pre-meeting - 1. SOP-AST-XXXXX Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 5_

_Signals: medium (words=241, tables=1)_

- Focus on disclosure of clinical study information as well as product information in clinical studies has increased in recent years due to implementation of regulations such as the US Final Rule, EUâ€™s EMA policy on publication of clinical data for medicinal products for human use (Policy 0070) and Health Canadaâ€™s Public Release of Clinical Information (PRCI).

- The data and documents that must be disclosed by study sponsors/applicants or Marketing Authorization Holders (MAH) can contain the following, due to these regulations:

- Companyâ€™s information (company-related secrets and procedures) which, if released, could result in significant harm to the companyâ€™s competitive market position and financial loss and give a significant advantage to its competitors,

- and/or

- Study participants or study personnel personal information (PI; also known protected personal data (PPD)).

- A companyâ€™s information classified as CCI, must not be released to the public.

- Astellas commits to following these disclosure regulations, and ensuring the protection and consistency of Astellas public disclosures in the public domain.

- Public domains in which Astellas information are disclosed include, but are not limited to, the following:

- Standards Overview

- To allow consistent data classification, FORM-AST-XXXX Public Disclosure Standards was developed based on criteria found in Attachment 2 Company Confidential Information (CCI) Decision Criteria. Based on new information, approach, regulations and/or requirements, Public Disclosure Standards may evolve and will be updated when necessary.

- Furthermore, FORM-AST-XXXX CCI Asset-specific Library Form, will be used as the basis for Asset-specific classification and described in this procedure.

**Table 1 (overview_table_1):**

| Phase 1-4 |
| --- |
| ClinicaTrials.gov / CTIS (EU CTR) / EU Clinical Trials Register (EU Directive, via EudraCT) / Japan jRCT / National/country specific registries / Company website (e.g., Astellas Clinical Trials) / Third-party website (e.g., TrialSummaries.com hosted by TrialScope) / Scientific journal websites/databases / Materials presented during cientific events and conferences |
| Phase 4 Additional Databases |
| HMA-EMA Catalogues of RWD studies (Non-interventional studies) / Health Authorities clinical data public websites/databases / Ad-hoc requests for Astellas documents submitted to EMA (Policy 0043) |

- This SOP applies to Astellas employees and non-employees who are involved in or contribute to public disclosure standards and tracking of the public disclosure activities of clinical studies (and the products in these studies) as mandated by laws/regulations. This SOP applies to Astellas information, data and/or documents that are made publicly available in support of public disclosure of clinical study information (including product information).

- The public domains in scope are listed in the OVERVIEW Section.

- Anonymization standards for documents for public disclosure are covered by STL-1938 Guide for Creating Redacted Documents for Public Disclosure.

- The following organizations are in scope of this document:

- Alliance Management

- Clinical Operations

- Communications & Investor Relations

- External Relations & Advocacy

- Data Science

- Development Project Management

- Early Development

- Intellectual Property

- Legal

- Medical Affairs (MA)

- Pharmacovigilance (PV)

- Primary Focus Development Divisions (PFDDs)

- Regulatory Affairs (RA)

- Research

- Rx+ Business Accelerator

- Technology & Manufacturing

- This SOP does not apply to corporate disclosures and/or media/investor relations disclosures, or information, data or documents shared with a third party or business partners under a relevant contractual or collaborative agreement. Refer to POL-1048 Disclosure Policy and POL-317 Global Policy on Third Party Lifecycle Management.

## SECTION 4: DEFINITIONS

_Slug: definitions_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 240916-1. SOP-AST-XXXXX Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 4_

_Signals: medium (words=20, tables=1)_

- For definitions, refer to Enterprise Master Definition List.

- Please see table below for definitions that are specific for this document:

**Table 1 (definitions_table_1):**

| Term | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Company Confidential Information (CCI) | In the context of this SOP and CCI included in public disclosures, CCI may refer to any non-public technical, scientific, business and other know-how and information, trade secrets, results and data of any type whatsoever in any media or format, including without limitation, ideas, discoveries, inventions, trade secrets, practices, manufacturing or analytical methods, tests, testing results, assays, techniques, specifications, processes, formulations, formulae, knowledge, know-how, skill, experience, materials, products and compositions, studies and procedures, drawings, plans, designs, diagrams, sketches, technology, databases, documentation or descriptions. Such data or information is also known as proprietary information. Confidential Information may also include intellectual property. / Any Confidential Information relating to the business activities of Astellas. This includes data or information that might be useful to competitors or that could be harmful to the company or others with whom Astellas does business if such data or information were disclosed, and includes data vital to the continued, successful operation of Astellas.  Refer to Attachment 2 Company Confidential Information (CCI) Decision Criteria. |
| Data | A piece of information (e.g., numerical, word) in any format/medium whether it is directly entered into a database or provided in a document. |
| Disclosing Party | Astellas employees and non-employees who will disclose information publicly. |
| Document | Any document provided for public disclosure, including but are not limited to: clinical study documents, marketing application modules, manuscripts, scientific publications, abstracts or presentations. |
| Public Disclosure | The act of sharing Astellas information (i.e., data and/or document) of clinical study information (including product information) in the public domain. |
| Public domain | The state of belonging or being available to the public as a whole, and therefore not subject to copyright.  Refer to the OVERVIEW Section for the list of public domains in scope. |

## SECTION 5: OVERVIEW

_Slug: overview_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 240916-1. SOP-AST-XXXXX Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 5_

_Signals: medium (words=230, tables=1)_

- Focus on disclosure of clinical study information as well as product information in clinical studies has increased in recent years due to implementation of regulations such as the US Final Rule, EUâ€™s EMA policy on publication of clinical data for medicinal products for human use (Policy 0070) and Health Canadaâ€™s Public Release of Clinical Information (PRCI).

- The data and documents that must be disclosed by study sponsors/applicants or Marketing Authorization Holders (MAH) can contain the following, due to these regulations:

- Companyâ€™s information (company-related secrets and procedures) which, if released, could result in significant harm to the companyâ€™s competitive market position and financial loss and give a significant advantage to its competitors,

- and/or

- Study participants or study personnel personal information (PI; also known as protected personal data (PPD)).

- A companyâ€™s information classified as CCI, must not be released to the public.

- Astellas commits to following these disclosure regulations and ensuring the protection and consistency of Astellas public disclosures in the public domain.

- Public domains in which Astellasâ€™ information are disclosed include, but are not limited to, the following:

- Standards Overview

- To allow consistent data classification, GUIDE-AST-XXXX CCI Public Disclosure Standards was developed. Based on new information, approach, regulations and/or requirements, CCI Public Disclosure Standards may evolve and will be updated when necessary.

- Furthermore, FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library, will be used as the basis for Asset-specific classification and described in this procedure.

**Table 1 (overview_table_1):**

| Phase 1-4 |
| --- |
| ClinicaTrials.gov / CTIS (EU CTR) / EU Clinical Trials Register (EU Directive, via EudraCT) / Japan jRCT / National/country specific registries / Company website (e.g., Astellas Clinical Trials) / Third-party website (e.g., TrialSummaries.com hosted by TrialScope) / Scientific journal websites/databases / Materials presented during scientific events and conferences |
| Phase 4 Additional Databases |
| HMA-EMA Catalogues of RWD studies (Non-interventional studies) / Health Authorities clinical data public websites/databases / Ad-hoc requests for Astellas documents submitted to EMA (Policy 0043) |

## SECTION 8: Creating a CCI Asset-specific Library for Public Disclosure

_Slug: creating_a_cci_asset_specific_library_for_public_disclosure_

_Layout: Heading 2_

_Source: 240916-1. SOP-AST-XXXXX Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 8_

_Signals: medium (words=108, tables=1)_

- It is essential that Asset-specific CCI is classified and disclosed in a consistent manner. Between Candidate Nomination (CN) Declaration and Investigational New Drug (IND) milestones, FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library should be initiated and developed. Re-assessment of existing CCI should be made when the Asset moves to a different phase e.g., Phase 1 to Phase 2 or when changes to Asset-specific CCIs are identified.

- The Asset Lead, in collaboration with the Asset Team, determines what information is considered CCI for the Asset. The Asset Lead is responsible for ensuring that FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library is created and reviewed for the asset prior to each of the asset development phases.

**Table 1 (creating_a_cci_asset_specific_library_for_public_disclosure_table_1):**

| Responsibility | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Public Disclosure Lead | Consult with Asset Lead or Delegate to initiate FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library. |
| Asset Lead or Delegate | Identify Asset-specific data as CCI using GUIDE-AST-XXXX CCI Public Disclosure Standards. / NOTE:  In GUIDE-AST-XXXX CCI Public Disclosure Standards, for "Information that May Be Considered CCIâ€, consult with the Subject Matter Expert, Department Head and/or appropriate Legal department, for guidance on appropriate CCI classification. |
| Asset Lead or Delegate | Document Asset-specific data in the Asset-specific FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library. |
| Asset Team | Review FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library. |
| Asset Lead or Delegate | Inform the Public Disclosure Lead that the FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library is final. |
| Public Disclosure Lead | Archive the final FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library. |
| Public Disclosure Lead | Inform the Disclosing Parties and Asset Lead that the final FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library is available for use. |

---

_Source: 240919-1. SOP-AST-XXXXX Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 2_

_Signals: low (words=62, tables=0)_

- The purpose of this Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) is to describe the process for creation and maintenance of public disclosure standards for determining Company Confidential Information (CCI) (herein referred to as public disclosure standards) applied to Astellas public disclosures (i.e., data and documents made publicly available). This SOP will also describe the process for collecting, compiling and tracking information on public disclosures.

## SECTION 2: PURPOSE

_Slug: purpose_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 240923-1. SOP-AST-XXXXX Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 2_

_Signals: low (words=62, tables=0)_

- The purpose of this Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) is to describe the process for creation and maintenance of public disclosure standards for determining Company Confidential Information (CCI) (herein referred to as public disclosure standards) applied to Astellas public disclosures (i.e., data and documents made publicly available). This SOP will also describe the process for collecting, compiling and tracking information on public disclosures.

---

## SECTION 3: SCOPE

_Slug: scope_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 240923-1. SOP-AST-XXXXX Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 3_

_Signals: medium (words=191, tables=0)_

- This SOP applies to Astellas employees and non-employees who are involved in or contribute to public disclosure standards and tracking of the public disclosure activities of clinical studies (and the products in these studies) as mandated by laws/regulations. This SOP applies to Astellas information, data and/or documents that are made publicly available in support of public disclosure of clinical study information (including product information).

- The public domains in scope are listed in the OVERVIEW Section.

- Anonymization standards for documents for public disclosure are covered by STL-1938 Guide for Creating Redacted Documents for Public Disclosure.

- The following organizations are in scope of this document:

- Alliance Management

- Clinical Operations

- Communications & Investor Relations

- External Relations & Advocacy

- Data Science

- Development Project Management

- Early Development

- Intellectual Property

- Legal

- Medical Affairs (MA)

- Pharmacovigilance (PV)

- Primary Focus Development Divisions (PFDDs)

- Regulatory Affairs (RA)

- Research

- Rx+ Business Accelerator

- Technology & Manufacturing

- This SOP does not apply to corporate disclosures and/or media/investor relations disclosures, or information, data or documents shared with a third party or business partners under a relevant contractual or collaborative agreement. Refer to POL-1048 Disclosure Policy and POL-317 Global Policy on Third Party Lifecycle Management.

---

## SECTION 4: DEFINITIONS

_Slug: definitions_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 240923-1. SOP-AST-XXXXX Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 4_

_Signals: medium (words=20, tables=1)_

- For definitions, refer to Enterprise Master Definition List.

- Please see table below for definitions that are specific for this document:

**Table 1 (definitions_table_1):**

| Term | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Company Confidential Information (CCI) | In the context of this SOP and CCI included in public disclosures, CCI may refer to any non-public technical, scientific, business and other know-how and information, trade secrets, results and data of any type whatsoever in any media or format, including without limitation, ideas, discoveries, inventions, trade secrets, practices, manufacturing or analytical methods, tests, testing results, assays, techniques, specifications, processes, formulations, formulae, knowledge, know-how, skill, experience, materials, products and compositions, studies and procedures, drawings, plans, designs, diagrams, sketches, technology, databases, documentation or descriptions. Such data or information is also known as proprietary information. Confidential Information may also include intellectual property. / Any Confidential Information relating to the business activities of Astellas. This includes data or information that might be useful to competitors or that could be harmful to the company or others with whom Astellas does business if such data or information were disclosed, and includes data vital to the continued, successful operation of Astellas.  Refer to Attachment 2 Company Confidential Information (CCI) Decision Criteria. |
| Data | A piece of information (e.g., numerical, word) in any format/medium whether it is directly entered into a database or provided in a document. |
| Disclosing Party | Astellas employees and non-employees who will disclose information publicly. |
| Document | Any document provided for public disclosure, including but are not limited to: clinical study documents, marketing application modules, manuscripts, scientific publications, abstracts or presentations. |
| Public Disclosure | The act of sharing Astellas information (i.e., data and/or document) of clinical study information (including product information) in the public domain. |
| Public domain | The state of belonging or being available to the public, and therefore not subject to copyright.  Refer to the OVERVIEW Section for the list of public domains in scope. |

---

## SECTION 5: OVERVIEW

_Slug: overview_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 240923-1. SOP-AST-XXXXX Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 5_

_Signals: medium (words=198, tables=1)_

- Disclosure of clinical study information as well as product information in clinical studies has increased in recent years due to implementation of disclosure regulations.

- The data and documents that must be disclosed by study sponsors/applicants or Marketing Authorization Holders (MAH) can contain the following, due to these regulations:

- Companyâ€™s information (company-related secrets and procedures) which, if released, could result in significant harm to the companyâ€™s competitive market position and financial loss and give a significant advantage to its competitors,

- and/or

- Study participants or study personnel personal information (PI; also known as protected personal data (PPD)).

- A companyâ€™s information classified as CCI, must not be released to the public. Astellas commits to following these disclosure regulations and ensuring the protection and consistency of Astellas public disclosures in the public domain. Public domains in which Astellasâ€™ information are disclosed include, but are not limited to, the following:

- Standards Overview

- To allow consistent data classification, GUIDE-AST-XXXX CCI Public Disclosure Standards was developed. Based on new information, approach, regulations and/or requirements, CCI Public Disclosure Standards may evolve and will be updated when necessary.

- Furthermore, FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library, will be used as the basis for Asset-specific classification and described in this procedure.

**Table 1 (overview_table_1):**

| Phase 1-4 |
| --- |
| ClinicaTrials.gov / CTIS (EU CTR) / EU Clinical Trials Register (EU Directive, via EudraCT) / Japan jRCT / National/country specific registries / Company website (e.g., Astellas Clinical Trials) / Third-party website (e.g., TrialSummaries.com hosted by TrialScope) / Scientific journal websites/databases / Materials presented during scientific events and conferences |
| Phase 4 Additional Databases |
| HMA-EMA Catalogues of RWD studies (Non-interventional studies) / Health Authorities clinical data public websites/databases / Ad-hoc requests for Astellas documents submitted to EMA (Policy 0043) |

## SECTION 8: Creating a CCI Asset-specific Library for Public Disclosure

_Slug: creating_a_cci_asset_specific_library_for_public_disclosure_

_Layout: Heading 2_

_Source: 240923-1. SOP-AST-XXXXX Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 8_

_Signals: medium (words=108, tables=1)_

- It is essential that Asset-specific CCI is classified and disclosed in a consistent manner. Between Candidate Nomination (CN) Declaration and Investigational New Drug (IND) milestones, FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library should be initiated and developed. Re-assessment of existing CCI should be made when the Asset moves to a different phase e.g., Phase 1 to Phase 2 or when changes to Asset-specific CCIs are identified.

- The Asset Lead, in collaboration with the Asset Team, determines what information is considered CCI for the Asset. The Asset Lead is responsible for ensuring that FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library is created and reviewed for the asset prior to each of the asset development phases.

**Table 1 (creating_a_cci_asset_specific_library_for_public_disclosure_table_1):**

| Responsibility | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Public Disclosure Lead | Consult with Asset Lead or Delegate to initiate FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library. |
| Asset Lead or Delegate | Identify Asset-specific data as CCI using GUIDE-AST-XXXX CCI Public Disclosure Standards. / NOTE:  In GUIDE-AST-XXXX CCI Public Disclosure Standards, for "Information that May Be Considered CCIâ€, consult with the Subject Matter Expert, Department Head and/or appropriate Legal department, for guidance on appropriate CCI classification. |
| Asset Lead or Delegate | Document Asset-specific data in the Asset-specific FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library, in collaboration with Asset Team. |
| Asset Lead or Delegate | Inform the Public Disclosure Lead that the FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library is final. |
| Public Disclosure Lead | Archive the final FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library. |
| Public Disclosure Lead | Inform the Disclosing Parties and Asset Lead that the final FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library is available for use. |

---

## SECTION 4: DEFINITIONS

_Slug: definitions_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 240930-Emily Comments 1. SOP-AST-XXXXX CCI Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 4_

_Signals: medium (words=20, tables=1)_

- For definitions, refer to Enterprise Master Definition List.

- Please see table below for definitions that are specific for this document:

**Table 1 (definitions_table_1):**

| Term | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Company Confidential Information (CCI) | In the context of this SOP and CCI included in public disclosures, CCI may refer to any non-public technical, scientific, business and other know-how and information, trade secrets, results and data of any type whatsoever in any media or format, including without limitation, ideas, discoveries, inventions, trade secrets, practices, manufacturing or analytical methods, tests, testing results, assays, techniques, specifications, processes, formulations, formulae, knowledge, know-how, skill, experience, materials, products and compositions, studies and procedures, drawings, plans, designs, diagrams, sketches, technology, databases, documentation or descriptions. Such data or information is also known as proprietary information. Confidential Information may also include intellectual property. / Any Confidential Information relating to the business activities of Astellas. This includes data or information that might be useful to competitors or that could be harmful to the company or others with whom Astellas does business if such data or information were disclosed, and includes data vital to the continued, successful operation of Astellas. |
| Data | A piece of information (e.g., numerical, word) in any format/medium whether it is directly entered into a database or provided in a document. |
| Disclosing Party | Astellas employees and non-employees who will disclose information publicly. |
| Document | Any document provided for public disclosure, including but are not limited to: clinical study documents, marketing application modules, manuscripts, scientific publications, abstracts or presentations. |
| Public Disclosure | The act of sharing Astellas information (i.e., data and/or document) of clinical study information (including product information) in the public domain. |
| Public domain | The state of belonging or being available to the public, and therefore not subject to copyright.  Refer to the OVERVIEW Section for the list of public domains in scope. |

## SECTION 5: OVERVIEW

_Slug: overview_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: 240930-Emily Comments 1. SOP-AST-XXXXX CCI Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 5_

_Signals: medium (words=198, tables=1)_

- Disclosure of clinical study information as well as product information in clinical studies has increased in recent years due to implementation of disclosure regulations.

- The data and documents that must be disclosed by study sponsors/applicants or Marketing Authorization Holders (MAH) can contain the following, due to these regulations:

- Companyâ€™s information (company-related secrets and procedures) which, if released, could result in significant harm to the companyâ€™s competitive market position and financial loss and give a significant advantage to its competitors,

- and/or

- Study participants or study personnel personal information (PI; also known as protected personal data (PPD)).

- A companyâ€™s information classified as CCI, must not be released to the public. Astellas commits to following these disclosure regulations and ensuring the protection and consistency of Astellas public disclosures in the public domain. Public domains in which Astellasâ€™ information are disclosed include, but are not limited to, the following:

- Standards Overview

- To allow consistent data classification, GUIDE-AST-XXXX CCI Public Disclosure Standards was developed. Based on new information, approach, regulations and/or requirements, CCI Public Disclosure Standards may evolve and will be updated when necessary.

- Furthermore, FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library, will be used as the basis for Asset-specific classification and described in this procedure.

**Table 1 (overview_table_1):**

| Phase 1-4 |
| --- |
| ClinicaTrials.gov / CTIS (EU CTR) / EU Clinical Trials Register (EU Directive, via EudraCT) / Japan jRCT / National/country specific registries / Company website (e.g., Astellas Clinical Trials) / Third-party website (e.g., TrialSummaries.com hosted by TrialScope) / Scientific journal websites/databases / Materials presented during scientific events and conferences |
| Phase 4 Additional Databases |
| HMA-EMA Catalogues of RWD studies (Non-interventional studies) / Health Authorities clinical data public websites/databases / Ad-hoc requests for Astellas documents submitted to EMA (Policy 0043) |

## SECTION 8: Creating a CCI Asset-specific Library for Public Disclosure

_Slug: creating_a_cci_asset_specific_library_for_public_disclosure_

_Layout: Heading 2_

_Source: 240930-Emily Comments 1. SOP-AST-XXXXX CCI Public Disclosure.docx | docx | Section 8_

_Signals: medium (words=109, tables=1)_

- It is essential that Asset-specific CCI is classified and disclosed in a consistent manner. Between Candidate Nomination (CN) Declaration and Investigational New Drug (IND) milestones, FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library should be initiated and developed. Re-assessment of existing CCI should be made when the Asset moves to a different development phase e.g., Phase 1 to Phase 2 or when changes to Asset-specific CCIs are identified.

- The Asset Lead, in collaboration with the Asset Team, determines what information is considered CCI for the Asset. The Asset Lead is responsible for ensuring that FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library is created and reviewed for the asset prior to each of the asset development phases.

**Table 1 (creating_a_cci_asset_specific_library_for_public_disclosure_table_1):**

| Responsibility | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Public Disclosure Lead | Consult with Asset Lead or Delegate to initiate FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library. |
| Asset Lead or Delegate | Identify Asset-specific data as CCI using GUIDE-AST-XXXX CCI Public Disclosure Standards. / NOTE:  In GUIDE-AST-XXXX CCI Public Disclosure Standards, for "Information that May Be Considered CCIâ€, consult with the Subject Matter Expert, Department Head and/or appropriate Legal department, for guidance on appropriate CCI classification. |
| Asset Lead or Delegate | Document Asset-specific data in the Asset-specific FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library, in collaboration with Asset Team. |
| Asset Lead or Delegate | Inform the Public Disclosure Lead that the FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library is final. |
| Public Disclosure Lead | Archive the final FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library. |
| Public Disclosure Lead | Inform the Disclosing Parties and Asset Lead that the final FORM-AST-XXXXX CCI Asset-specific Library is available for use. |

## SECTION 1: SUMMARY_Data_Disclosure_Standards_WS1_Workshop_WORKBOOK

_Slug: summary_data_disclosure_standards_ws1_workshop_workbook_

_Layout: Document_

_Source: SUMMARY_Data_Disclosure_Standards_WS1_Workshop_WORKBOOK.docx | docx | Section 1_

- DATA DISCLOSURE STANDARDS WORKBOOK

- STRATEGIC PLAN - DATA DISCLOSURE STANDARDS

- PURPOSE

- The purpose of this document is to provide data disclosure standards for determining of Company Confidential Information (CCI) that can be applied to any Astellas asset during the development and post-approval phases for which the information is in the public domain.

- Data disclosed by study sponsors/applicants or Marketing Authorization Holders (MAH) can contain:

- Companyâ€™s information (company-related secrets and procedures) which, if released, could result in significant harm to the companyâ€™s competitive market position and financial loss and give a significant advantage to its competitors

- And/or

- Study participants or study personnel personal information (PI; also known as PPD - protected personal data)

- Anonymization methods and standards used to anonymize protected personal data are NOT covered in this document.

- DEFINITIONS and terms used for data disclosure standards

- SCOPE

- Any information, data or documents that are shared in the public domain.

- Information shared outside of Astellas and covered by a relevant contractual or collaborative agreement is not included in the scope of public disclosure.

- The public domains in which Astellas information is disclosed include, but are not limited to, the following:

- data disclosure standards - How to Determine If the Information is Considered CCI?

- COMPANY CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION (CCI) BASIC DECISION TREE APPLICABLE TO ANY DEVELOPMENT PHASE (1)

- If the information can be found online via search engine, the company website, public databases or previous publications, the information is NOT CCI

- If the information is not proprietary information, the information is NOT CCI

- If the information does not undermine the companyâ€™s legitimate economic interest or competitive position, the information is NOT CCI

- If the publication of the information does not give an advantage to competitors to advance their products, the information is NOT CCI

- If the information is relevant and critical for understanding the study and the documents published, the information MAY NOT BE CCI and may require further confirmation from the SME.

- WHAT INFORMATION MAY OR MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED COMPANY CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION (CCI)?

- Clinical Related Information

- With a few exceptions, clinical information is not considered CCI.

- Nonclinical and Analytical Test Method Related Information

- Most nonclinical and biopharmaceutical information is not considered CCI.

- CMC and Quality Related Information

- Detailed description of manufacturing processes is always considered CC. General information and/or general description of the appropriateness of the methods used is not CCI.

- Regulatory Related Information

- PV Related Information

- Centralized â€œLibraryâ€ of CCIs per Asset

- The centralized library of CCIs per asset is developed for new assets (entering or in Phase 1 development):

- It supports a consistent decision-making process in CCI assessment for disclosure of data by Astellas and external disclosures by Astellas business partners and sponsors of the studies that use Astellas products.

- It requires updates. Maintenance and updates will be required when the asset enters a next development stage (e.g., reassessment of the CCI when the product is in phase 2 or 3)

- Example:

Coli K-12) / For biotechnology products, a general description of the active ingredient including the type 253 of molecule and its general structural features or of the type of producer cell / Information on the substances originating / from humans and other organisms (e.g., bovine foetus serum) / General information on the characterization of the active substance and statements confirming that the molecule is appropriately characterized / A general description of the type of test methods used and the appropriateness of the specification / Excipient names / Standard storage conditions, such as the storage temperature and period that are described in relevant guidelines / Units of the temperature, humidity and storage period in stability tests / Forms of the packaging / Conditions for creating deteriorated products, if published / Test condition and measurement value units for information on light deterioration or heat deterioration tests / Batch numbers / The fact that the synthesis or manufacturing procedure was changed* / The fact that the formulation was changed during the development program and the description of changes and bioequivalence tests * / Common purification procedures / Common techniques such as dissolution, mixing, filtration, etc. / Types and names of solvent, techniques if such information is published / *May be considered CCI for AAV In vivo therapies |
| Nonclinical Related Information | Nonclinical Related Information |
| Novel pharmaceutical concepts if not published / Novel mode of action if not published / Metabolites: if the manufacturing method of the active ingredient can be inferred through publication of such information / Innovative methods and/or study design if not published / Tests conducted using a special substrate (created synthetically) and the name of the substrate / Special test and test methods: special test animal species or strains, test methods, rationale for setting tests, etc. / Detailed information on analytical methods such as reagents, equipment, instruments, materials, etc. / Information on partners/third parties such as suppliers / Information on study sites: location, names of CROs and testing facilities, details about the facilities / Information on future development plans:  evaluation of new formulation, innovative technology, or exploration of the effect of the medicinal product in new indications or populations, etc | Information on test methods / Commonly used techniques such as titration, ELISA and Biacore analysis / Techniques published in scientific publications and papers / Quantitation limits/lower limits and upper limits of pharmacokinetic and pharmacologic tests / Drug concentration measurements / Information on labelling, such as labelling nuclide and labelled locus / The test methods if the study is conducted using a standard dissolution study procedure / Numeric values if the dissolution study results have been published / The names of solvents used in studies / Nonclinical study results / Names of countries where nonclinical studies were conducted |
| Clinical Related Information | Clinical Related Information |
| Dose related information about the drug product (study intervention): unit dose strength and strength of active substance, daily dose allowed, and maximum dose allowed for the medicinal product under investigation on justified grounds, i.e. when the specific information on the posology is not in the public domain and constitutes patentable matter, the disclosure of which before a patent application is filed (typically, after the completion of the trial and during the trial readout) would jeopardize its protection â€“ phase 1and phase 1/2 integrated trials / Biomarkers: new or novel methodologies not yet qualified (not disclosed in the public domain), including new methodologies to support future developments as regards secondary or exploratory endpoints / Innovative study designs and/or innovative analytical methods: company developed or modified assays and immunogenicity assays exclusively used by the company as the novel assays and not published / Information on critical reagents: not commonly used or not published / Information on validation of innovative analytical methods: innovative assays or assays and/or test methods modified or developed exclusively by the company or another third party and used exclusively by the company and not published / Study Endpoints and Results collected not supportive of the label: not supportive of a label (or future label claim) claim and not taken into consideration in the overall benefit/risk evaluation / Questionnaires, diaries, and other patient-facing materials provided by the third-party: written agreements between the sponsor and the third-party service provider expressly establish that patient facing documents (e.g. patient questionnaires) cannot be disclosed publicly / Information on future development plans: evaluation of new formulation, innovative technology, or exploration of the effect of the medicinal product in new indications or populations, studies which are part of ongoing Pediatric Investigation Plan (PIP) / Information that may reveal strategic (contractual) agreements / Advice from Health Authority: detailed information about the scientific advice received from HAs | Information on study design and procedures / Rationale for the target patient population / Statistical techniques employed / Clinical study results / Information on the concurrent therapies / General information on PK/PD models, parameters, and the results of the PK/PD model simulations / Names of CROs and vendors involved in study conduct, duties and functions, including central laboratories, IVRS provider, image reading centers, conduct of assays / The fact that a consultation with HAs took place |
| Pharmacovigilance Related Information (RMP) | Pharmacovigilance Related Information (RMP) |
| Exposure data: patient exposure and sales volume by country / Projected exposure: projected post-authorization exposure data / Information on future development plans: evaluation of new formulation, innovative technology, or exploration of the effect of the medicinal product in new indications or populations, studies which are part of ongoing Pediatric Investigation Plan (PIP) |   |

## SECTION 2: CCI Asset-specific Library for Public Disclosure â€“ Created by the Asset Lead

_Slug: cci_asset_specific_library_for_public_disclosure_created_by_the_asset_lead_

_Layout: Heading 1_

_Source: Public Disclosure Standards_Updated_22Aug2024.docx | docx | Section 2_

_Signals: medium (words=103, tables=1)_

- The Asset-specific Library is developed by the Asset Lead in collaboration with the Asset Team to help identify asset-specific CCI prior to each development phase:

- It should be created using the general public disclosure standards as the guidance (Section 1 above)

- It will support a consistent decision-making process in CCI assessment in documents and information for public disclosure

- It will help facilitate the review of documents and information for public disclosure

- It will require updates. Maintenance and updates will be required when the asset enters a next development stage (e.g., reassessment of the CCI when the product is in phase 2 or 3)

**Table 1 (cci_asset_specific_library_for_public_disclosure_created_by_the_asset_lead_table_1):**

| Proposed Format/Concept Draft â€“ Final to be Confirmed | Proposed Format/Concept Draft â€“ Final to be Confirmed |
| --- | --- |
| Asset Development Code/INN Name | ASPXXXX |
| Development Phase | Phase 1 |
| Type of Information | Information Identified as CCI |
| CMC/Quality Related | <Information identified as CCI during Phase 1 development applied to any document or information required for the public disclosure> / <Example>: All CMC/Quality information identified as CCI in the Data Disclosure Standards |
| Nonclinical Related Information | <Information identified as CCI during Phase 1 development applied to any document or information required for the public disclosure> / <Example>: / description of the novel mechanism of action / description of the special substrate used in the tests conducted in nonclinical studies |
| Clinical Related Information | <Information identified as CCI during Phase 1 development applied to any document or information required for the public disclosure> / <Example>: / description of the novel biomarkers used in phase 1 studies / unit dose strength in phase 1 and integrated phase 1/2 studies |
